title: Early tunes and how Buddy Petit picked up repertoire
summary: Buddy Petit could not read but heard popular numbers and bands, then ran them over on the bandstand for the band to catch.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
